title: Shared interview session wire shapes kept only in memory
description: Presence never reaches state.json. `heartbeat` is the POST /api/heartbeat body: `visible` is the Page Visibility state, `lastInput` the seconds since the person's last key, pointer or touch, and `away` is true while the person's own Away (the snooze) lasts; the page drops it on their next input. `presence` is one entry of the snapshot's `presence` list: `active`, or `away` with `since`, the server time the person went away. Someone with no heartbeat for 90 s is offline and absent from the list.
